purpose: Machine-readable gates for the controlled public-beta launch handoff.

statusSemantics.ready: The repository contains the implementation and verification evidence for this gate.
statusSemantics.operator-action: The repository documents the gate, but a deployment operator must configure or exercise it.
statusSemantics.external-action: The repository cannot complete the gate without external creators, users, or feedback.

gates.title: Public operational status and dashboard boundary
Privacy-conscious beta feedback and metrics templates
Hosted registry dependencies and live integration
requiredActions: Provision PostgreSQL, apply the checked-in migrations, and enable point-in-time recovery.
Provision private S3-compatible artifact storage with immutable/digest-addressed objects.
Configure the server-only GitHub provider broker and registry session settings.
Run the opt-in PostgreSQL/object-store integration harness in the target environment.

gates.title: Operational probes and alert routing
requiredActions: Inject bounded database, storage, worker, and moderation probes into GET /v1/status.
Expose worker readiness and queue lag through the hosting platform health path.
Route outage, stale-lease, queue-lag, and repeated-failure alerts to an on-call channel.
Exercise the incident runbook once with a staging failure and preserve evidence.

gates.title: CLI release key custody and distribution
requiredActions: Store AGENTCARGO_CLI_RELEASE_PRIVATE_KEY in a protected CI secret or approved key service.
Restrict tag/manual release permissions and rotate or revoke keys through an operator procedure.
Publish the matching public key and fingerprint through a trusted release channel.
Verify a signed bundle from the release channel before public distribution.

gates.title: Hosted policy and data-governance setup
requiredActions: Fill the hosted legal entity, jurisdiction, privacy contact, and support channel.
List subprocessors and configure published cookie, deletion, backup, log, and evidence-retention periods.
Review the policy documents with qualified counsel before inviting external users.

gates.title: External creator onboarding
requiredActions: Invite at least 10 external creators and record whether each publishes without maintainer intervention.
Collect structured feedback on validation, scanner findings, publication, and recovery paths.

gates.title: External installation and beta learning targets
requiredActions: Reach 100 successful installs outside the core project team.
Measure at least 95 percent installation success across the supported host/scope/OS matrix.
Record search-to-detail, detail-to-install, checksum, failure, and time-to-first-success observations.
Invite at least one independently maintained adapter or validation rule.
